svg.title: Schwitzer agent harness flow
svg.desc: Top: the stages of one task from Idea to Done, with the human decisions (buttons in the app) above and the agent actions (/schwitzer commands and schwitzer_* tools) below. Bottom left: one tool call from omp through the plugin and the app's MCP server to the room server and every member. Bottom right: one live session, from the claim marker through the omp session log and the app's scanner to every member's sessions panel.
svg.text: Humans decide in the app · agents work through the omp plugin and the app's MCP server · every step is a room event
Human decision — a button in the app
Agent action — /schwitzer command or schwitzer_* tool
Stage lamp, as in the app's task list
Files on disk — omp session logs
The server has no roles; the app keeps decisions human: Decide exists only as buttons, never as an MCP tool.
reads schwitzer.json and <data_dir>/mcp-token · initialize → tools/call → DELETE
Origin → 403 · wrong token → 401 · 30 s per tool · no decide tools
validate → change → commit → Event to every member over /events
from schwitzer_claim or the Pick prompt
plugin puts it into the prompt
a user message, so it lands in
written by omp, read only by the app
cwd outside a linked repo: never leaves
